mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1800 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when HOUST > 1800, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% indicates tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low unemployment rates (UNRATE) below 5% sustain labor market strength, contributing to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 30% of instances when UNRATE < 5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeds 2% YoY and GDP (GDPC1) growth surpasses 3% YoY, the combined effect predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in late-cycle expansions, a rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above $350 billion signals sustained consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of instances when RSAFS > 350B in late-cycle expansions, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the spread between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL inflation rate (as a proxy for real interest rates) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when the spread is above 2%.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when the spread is above 2% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 150,000 new jobs signals labor market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 35% of instances when PAYEMS > 150,000, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeds 1.5% YoY and unemployment rates (UNRATE) fall below 4.5%, the combined effect predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to potential overheating.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
